name: Criminal Past: the granted +X/+0 counts creature cards in its controller's graveyard
notes: 'Commander creatures you own have menace and "This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard."' gave the commander menace and the quoted text but no boost: the granted-ability pass only read a fixed '+N/+N'. The quoted 'where X is the number of' count now goes through the for-each machinery (forEachDesc / _computeForEachCount), per carrier of the grant. Two creature cards and one noncreature card in your graveyard, a creature card in the opponent's (not counted): commander Isamaru 2/2 becomes 4/2. Grizzly Bears is not a commander and stays 2/2. Criminal Past is added without suppressPrompt: the quoted count must not raise the add-time X prompt (which defaulted to 0 and rewrote the ability to '+0/+0, where 0 is ...'); the harness throws if prompt() is reached. That part is only checked when this fixture is built: restoring a board never prompts. Re-applied from old/criminal-past-granted-x (07aac95) on 2026-11-22 with the count's words kept ("in your graveyard" says whose).
